page_title: LEV 6-3 WOL | Bayer Leverkusen v Wolfsburg 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 6 - 3 Goal! Ernest Poku plays a simple square pass into the feet of Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the roof of the net. 6:3.
90+5' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.

90+1' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Kamil Grabara pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Kofane.
86' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 9:5.
83' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
83' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) replaces Sael Kumbedi.
81' Substitution. Christian Eriksen makes his way off the pitch and Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
81' Substitution. Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) in, Jonas Wind out.
81' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Nathan Tella will be replaced by Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) squanders a big chance. He takes a rebound inside the box and smashes the ball against the right post!
81' A fine pass finds Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Kamil Grabara reacts superbly to deny him.
77' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
77' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

76' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Mark Flekken anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
76' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
73' 5 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) was set free in the area by Exequiel Palacios and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the right side of the net. 5:3.
73' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.

73' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kamil Grabara. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
72' Referee Martin Petersen halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Dieter Hecking, then shows him a yellow.
71' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
71' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
68' 4 - 3 Goal! Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 4:3.
67' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
66' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg).

65' Ambitious effort from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
63' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

62' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
60' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
55' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
53' 3 - 3 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kamil Grabara to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
53' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Bayer Leverkusen!
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
49' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.

49' Well-positioned Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
48' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
47' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Kasper Hjulmand has made a change at the break. Patrik Schick has come on in place of Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' Martin Petersen blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Martin Petersen no option but to blow his whistle.
45+3' Dangerous play by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen). Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

44' 2 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
42' Great ball in from Alejandro Grimaldo. Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
39' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
38' 1 - 3 Goal! Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mark Flekken to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
38' Dieter Hecking isn't happy on the touchline after referee Martin Petersen shows him a yellow card.
38' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
37' Martin Petersen shows the yellow card to Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) for a heavy challenge.
37' It’s a PENALTY to Wolfsburg after the VAR review!
36' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Wolfsburg! Let's see what he decides.
36' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up an injury.
33' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
31' 1 - 2 Goal! Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 1:2.
30' 1 - 1 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Kamil Grabara to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
30' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
29' The whistle blows and Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is booked for an infringement.

28' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Martin Petersen has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Bayer Leverkusen.

27' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Kamil Grabara has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
24' Close! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
22' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
22' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.
21' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by Kamil Grabara.
18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.
18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
16' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a brilliant pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net by striking the ball past the goalkeeper!
15' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
14' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
12' Poor challenge! Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for tripping and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
11' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner which is cleared.
8' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
7' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just past the left post.
6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
4' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Martin Petersen blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick near the side line.
4' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
2' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
